pathways: regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: MALT1 encodes mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma translocation protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include endopeptidase activity and peptidase activity. It participates in regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to combined immunodeficiency due to MALT1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Marginal zone lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
